mapper.sql: select id, trace_id, scene, capability, provider_code, channel_id, model_id, attempt, input_tokens, output_tokens, image_count, elapsed_ms, status, error_code, request_digest, operator, create_time from ai_call_log
mapper.insert: insert into ai_call_log ( trace_id, scene, capability, provider_code, channel_id, model_id, attempt, input_tokens, output_tokens, image_count, elapsed_ms, status, error_code, request_digest, operator, create_time ) values ( #{traceId}, #{scene}, #{capability}, #{providerCode}, #{channelId}, #{modelId}, #{attempt}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{imageCount}, #{elapsedMs}, #{status}, #{errorCode}, #{requestDigest}, #{operator}, sysdate() )
